agentic.summary: A LangGraph supervisor coordinates specialised agents over a governed data platform. Every answer and every routed case passes guardrails, and every release passes an evaluation gate.

bands.title: Guardrails
bands.text: Schema-constrained SQL, PII masking, role-based access

bands.title: Reliability
bands.text: Retries, timeouts, fallback to curated SQL

bands.title: Observability
bands.text: LangSmith traces, cost and latency per agent

flow: Ingest: reviews and surveys land daily, are validated and mapped to the 466-entity hierarchy with the right weights for that period.
Detect: the anomaly agent compares theme volume and sentiment per entity against weighted baselines and flags emerging spikes.
Classify: the theme agent labels each flagged cluster with a root-cause theme and attaches representative evidence.
Route: the routing agent opens a case with the owning operations team, with priority, evidence and the affected entities.
Ask: executives ask questions in plain language; the supervisor answers from curated SQL first and uses constrained text-to-SQL only for new questions.
Verify: guardrails validate generated SQL against the schema; failures retry, then fall back to the closest curated answer.
Improve: every release runs the 165-question harness, and production traces feed new cases into the regression set.

agents.name: Supervisor
agents.role: Understands intent and decides which agent or path handles the request
agents.guard: Intent confidence threshold, safe default to curated path

agents.name: Anomaly detection
agents.role: Finds abnormal theme and sentiment shifts per entity
agents.guard: Minimum volume and weighted baselines to avoid noise

agents.name: Theme classification
agents.role: Assigns root-cause themes and picks evidence
agents.guard: Fixed taxonomy, low-confidence items sent for review

agents.name: Text-to-SQL
agents.role: Answers new analytical questions over governed tables

agents.name: Routing and action
agents.role: Creates and assigns cases to operations teams

research.summary: Discovery combined executive interviews, time with site operations teams and analysis of the existing feedback corpus to find where insight was being lost.

personas.name: Group CXO
personas.about: Owns customer experience across brands and entities.
goals: One trusted NPS view across the group
pains: Numbers differ by brand and team
personas.needs: An executive summary they can drill into and trust.

personas.name: Site operations manager
personas.about: Runs delivery and handover for a set of projects.
goals: Know which issues need action this week
pains: No clear owner for recurring issues
personas.needs: Routed cases with evidence and priority, not another dashboard.

personas.name: CX analyst
personas.about: Answers leadership questions about customer feedback.
personas.needs: Governed metrics and natural-language queries that are provably correct.

personas.name: Home buyer
personas.about: Bought a home and is going through possession and after-sales service.
pains: No visibility of who is handling it
personas.needs: Issues fixed before they need to escalate.

insights.insight: Executives did not trust AI-generated numbers they could not trace.
insights.decision: Curated SQL first, constrained text-to-SQL second, with an accuracy gate on every release.

insights.insight: Operations teams rarely opened dashboards but acted quickly on assigned work.
insights.decision: Push routed cases with evidence into ops queues instead of adding more charts.

insights.insight: Group restructuring made year-on-year comparisons misleading.
insights.decision: Model time-varying entity weights so history stays comparable.

agentic.summary: A retrieval-augmented assistant built as a chain of planning, retrieval, generation and checking steps, wrapped in a quality and cost loop that decides what ships.

bands.title: Evaluation
bands.text: Accuracy, hallucination and safety gates, 94% caught pre-deploy

bands.title: Cost
bands.text: Model routing and caching, 52% lower inference cost

flow: Ask: a finance or procurement user asks about an SLA, renewal or contract term; access is checked against their role.
Plan: the planner rewrites the question and decides which sources are needed.
Retrieve: Cognitive Search returns the most relevant contract passages and warehouse facts the user is allowed to see.
Generate: the model drafts an answer grounded only in retrieved content.
Check: guardrails test for unsupported claims, unsafe content and policy breaches before anything is shown.
Cite: the formatter attaches sources so every number can be audited.
Gate: every change runs the evaluation suites, and production telemetry tracks quality, latency and cost.

agents.name: Query planner
agents.role: Rewrites the question and picks sources
agents.guard: Restricted to allowed sources per role

agents.name: Citation formatter
agents.guard: No answer shown without a citation

research.summary: Research focused on how finance and procurement users actually looked up contract information, and on where LLM features were failing in practice.

personas.name: Procurement manager
personas.about: Manages vendor contracts and renewals.
goals: Find renewal dates and SLAs fast
personas.needs: Instant answers with the source clause attached.

personas.name: Finance controller
personas.about: Tracks commitments and spend against contracts.
personas.needs: Cited, auditable answers it can rely on.

personas.name: Product engineer
personas.about: Ships LLM features into production.
personas.needs: Automated quality gates in the release path.

personas.name: Compliance officer
personas.about: Owns financial compliance and data access.
goals: Right people see the right data
personas.needs: RBAC, content filtering and an audit trail.

insights.insight: Users only trusted answers that showed where the number came from.
insights.decision: Citations became mandatory for every answer.

insights.insight: The most damaging failures were confident but invented figures.
insights.decision: A hallucination gate now blocks releases that regress.

insights.insight: A large share of spend came from repeated, similar questions.
insights.decision: Caching and model routing cut inference cost by 52%.

research.summary: Research combined funnel analytics across the app with support-contact analysis and incident reviews to find where customers and operators were failing.

personas.name: First-time credit user
personas.about: Mobile-first customer applying for small-ticket credit.
personas.needs: A fast journey with clear status at every step.

personas.name: Repeat customer
personas.about: Existing user of the super app's commerce and health services.
personas.needs: Relevant, pre-approved offers inside journeys already in use.

personas.name: Credit and risk manager
personas.about: Owns credit policy and portfolio quality.
personas.needs: Configurable decisioning with clear guardrails.

personas.name: Support agent
personas.about: Resolves failed and stuck transactions.
pains: No visibility into where a transaction failed
personas.needs: Event-level status and a clear next action.

insights.insight: The most common contact was 'where is my application or disbursal'.
insights.decision: Lifecycle events drive proactive status updates to customers.

insights.insight: Many drop-offs happened at KYC vendor failures.
insights.decision: Retry and fallback routing across verification providers.

insights.insight: Pre-approved users converted far better than cold offers.
insights.decision: Propensity models decide who sees which cross-sell offer.

research.summary: Discovery mapped the partner onboarding process and the credit operations workflow end to end to find what actually limited growth.

personas.name: Partner integration lead
personas.about: Brings a fintech or merchant partner onto the lending platform.
goals: Go live in days, not months
personas.needs: Standard APIs and configuration-based onboarding.

personas.name: Credit analyst
personas.about: Reviews and approves loan applications.
personas.needs: Automation for routine cases, focus on exceptions.

personas.name: Risk head
personas.about: Sets credit policy.
pains: Engineering releases for every rule change
personas.needs: A rule engine risk teams can own.

personas.name: Borrower
personas.about: Applies for a loan through a partner.
personas.needs: Instant decisions and self-service support.

insights.insight: Most onboarding delay was configuration and paperwork, not code.
insights.decision: Standardised partner configuration cut onboarding from 60 days to 2.

insights.insight: The majority of applications were straightforward.
insights.decision: ML instant decisioning for routine cases, humans on exceptions.

insights.insight: A handful of intents made up most support requests.
insights.decision: An NLP chatbot automated them, reducing manual load by 60%.

research.summary: Research analysed the ticket corpus and shadowed support agents to understand why customers contacted support more than once.

personas.name: New investor
personas.about: Opening a first trading account.
personas.needs: Fast, automated document verification.

personas.name: Active trader
personas.about: Trades frequently and depends on payouts and order execution.
personas.needs: Right team on the first attempt.

personas.name: Support agent
personas.about: Handles email and chat queries.
personas.needs: Pre-classified tickets and automated answers for common asks.

personas.name: KYC reviewer
personas.about: Verifies identity and fraud checks.
personas.needs: Automation with a full audit trail.

insights.insight: Repeat contacts were driven mostly by misrouting.
insights.decision: Classification and routing came before full automation.

insights.insight: Slow KYC was the biggest barrier to activation.
insights.decision: Document AI cut verification from 2 days to 30 minutes.

research.summary: As co-founder, research ran continuously through learner interviews, funnel data and experiments.

personas.name: Exam aspirant
personas.about: Student preparing for a competitive exam.
personas.needs: Instant, relevant feedback on every attempt.

personas.name: Parent or payer
personas.about: Pays for the course on the student's behalf.
personas.needs: Clear progress reporting and simple payment.

personas.name: Educator
personas.about: Creates and sells course content.
personas.needs: AI-assisted evaluation and reliable delivery.

personas.name: Support lead
personas.about: Handles learner queries.
personas.needs: Fewer failure points in the journey.

insights.insight: Drop-off clustered at checkout and first-use.
insights.decision: Simplified purchase and onboarding lifted completion by 50%.

insights.insight: Feedback speed drove retention more than content volume.
Exam-season spikes caused most outages and tickets.
insights.decision: Horizontal scaling and retry handling for 99.9% uptime.
